pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the owner group to update

attributes.name: FiscalYearEnd
attributes.description: The month number representing the end of the fiscal year

attributes.name: OwnerPacketBasis
attributes.description: The accounting method used for owner packet calculations. Valid values are "Cash" or "Accrual".

attributes.name: PaymentType
attributes.description: The type of payment distribution for the owners. Valid values are "Net Income" or "Flat".

attributes.name: PaymentAmount
attributes.description: The fixed payment amount to distribute to owners. This value is required when PaymentType is "Flat".

attributes.name: StartDate
attributes.description: The date when this ownership group becomes effective. The date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format and cannot be set in the future. When updating an existing property's ownership, this date must be later than the current ownership group's StartDate. Creating a new owner group will automatically set the previous owner group's EndDate to one day before this StartDate to maintain ownership continuity.

attributes.name: ReserveFunds
attributes.description: The amount of funds to maintain in reserve for the property

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated owner group
